requirements.statement: Any signed-in user can open a new round for the current day by specifying a restaurant name and a cutoff time, and only one round may be open at a time.

criteria.must: A signed-in user can open a round by providing a restaurant name and a cutoff time
Attempting to open a new round while one is already open is rejected
The opener may optionally add notes when opening a round

requirements.statement: Any signed-in user can see the currently open round's restaurant, cutoff time, and the items added so far, including who added each.

criteria.must: The open round view shows the restaurant name and cutoff time
The open round view lists all items added so far along with who added each one

requirements.statement: Any signed-in user can add one or more items (description, quantity, price) to the open round before cutoff, and after cutoff the system rejects new items with a clear message.

criteria.must: A signed-in user can add an item with description, quantity, and price to the open round before cutoff
A signed-in user can add multiple items to the same round
Attempting to add an item after the round's cutoff time is rejected with a clear error message

requirements.statement: A user can edit or remove items they personally added while the round is still open, but cannot edit or remove another teammate's items.

criteria.must: A user can edit an item they personally added while the round is open
A user can remove an item they personally added while the round is open
A user attempting to edit another teammate's item is rejected
A user attempting to remove another teammate's item is rejected

requirements.statement: Once the cutoff time passes, the round is automatically considered closed, becoming read-only history with no further item additions or edits allowed.

criteria.must: A round automatically transitions to closed once its cutoff time passes
No items can be added to a round once it has passed cutoff
No items can be edited or removed on a round once it has passed cutoff

requirements.statement: The opener may manually close their round before the cutoff time.

criteria.must: The round's opener can manually close the round before its cutoff time
A user who is not the round's opener cannot manually close the round

requirements.statement: Once a round is closed, the opener and any teammate can view the consolidated order: items grouped by description with total quantities, a per-person list of items and cost total, and a grand total.

criteria.must: The consolidated order view is available once a round is closed
The consolidated order groups items by description with summed quantities
The consolidated order shows a per-person list of items and that person's cost total
The consolidated order shows a grand total for the round
Any signed-in teammate, not only the opener, can view the consolidated order of a closed round

requirements.statement: Past closed rounds remain viewable as a simple list/history view showing who ordered what, from where, and on what day.

criteria.must: A history view lists past closed rounds with restaurant and date
Selecting a past round from history shows who ordered what in that round

requirements.statement: The app posts a message to the team's Slack channel when a round opens and again at cutoff, with no email notifications.

criteria.must: A Slack message is posted to the team channel when a round opens
A Slack message is posted to the team channel when a round closes at cutoff
No email notifications are sent by the app

requirements.statement: Users sign in with the company's existing Google Workspace account (SSO), with no separate signup/password flow.

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in via Google Workspace SSO before using the app
The app provides no separate signup or password-based account creation flow
